description: This file defines the ErrorRule class which extends AbstractRule and is responsible for evaluating certain conditions related to error handling within the AWS EndpointV2 ruleset, and throwing exceptions if those conditions are met.

classes.name: ErrorRule
classes.description: A class that evaluates error conditions based on provided definitions and throws an UnresolvedEndpointException when conditions are met.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ErrorRule with a definition array, extracting the 'error' key.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the error information stored in the rule.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Checks if the rule's conditions are satisfied; if so, throws an UnresolvedEndpointException with a resolved error message.
